description: This file provides utilities for seeding a database with initial data using JSON files, specifically for roles, competencies, role adjacency, and role competencies, via SQLAlchemy. It includes functions for creating database tables if they don't exist, loading JSON data, and performing idempotent upserts to ensure consistent seed data.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _load_json(file_name: str)
methods.description: Loads a JSON array from a specified file within the data directory, returning None if the file doesn't exist or isn't a valid JSON array.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_tables(db: Session)
methods.description: Ensures the essential catalog tables exist in the database, creating them if necessary, to support seeding operations.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_roles(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update operations for role records based on unique 'code'.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update operations for competency records based on unique 'code'.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_adjacency(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts role adjacency relationships, identified by from_role_id and to_role_id.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts role-to-competency requirement records, identified by role_id and competency_id.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_catalog_from_json()
methods.description: Main public function that loads data from JSON files and seeds the database with roles, competencies, adjacency, and mappings, creating minimal defaults if files are missing, ensuring idempotency.
